description: WHAT: www pointer only — invoice line items are computed on www MCP. maps accepts situationKey/whenKey/breakdown for symmetry but returns html link to /preise, not totals. DOES NOT return totalEur. NEXT: @ikeytz/mcp get_invoice_line_items; get_ort_datetime here for Berlin clock/whenKey.

breakdown.description: www flag; ignored for maps pointer payload.

locale.description: maps is German-only (de). Omit or pass de. Other values are ignored; URLs stay https://maps.ikeytz.com/… with no locale prefix. Not a www multi-locale switch — use @ikeytz/mcp list_locales on www for en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr.

situationKey.description: Required for www. Situation id (opening_slam, opening_locked, pkg_key_*, cylinder_only, cylinder_mount, aliases).

whenKey.description: day|night|now — used on www; maps only points.

name: get_invoice_line_items
title: Get Invoice Line Items
